Report DescriptionUPDATE TO NRC REPORT 1297761: CALLER REPORTED THERE WERE 14 ADDITIONAL RAIL CARS THAT DERAILED AT THE INCIDENT SITE"S CLASS YARD. THE ORIGINAL SET OF DERAILED RAIL CARS AND LOCOMOTIVES DERAILED IN THE RECEIVING YARD. CALLER PROVIDED IDENTIFICATION OF THE ORIGINAL DERAILED RAIL CARS, LOCOMOTIVE, AND ADDITIONAL RAIL CARS ASSOCIATED WITH THIS INCIDENT. TWO OF THE DERAILED LOCOMOTIVES HAD PUNCTURED FUEL TANKS WHICH CAUSED A RELEASE OF DIESEL FUEL ON THE BALLAST OF THE RAIL YARD. THERE WERE NO IDENTIFICATION NUMBERS KNOWN FOR THE ONE OF THE LOCOMOTIVES AND FOR THE THREE DERAILED RAIL CARS. THERE WERE NO INJURIES OR FATALITIES WITH THIS INCIDENT.

Report DescriptionCALLER IS REPORTING A COMMERCIAL AIRCRAFT DIVERTED TO DULLES AIRPORT DUE TO THERMAL RUNAWAY OF A LITHIUM BATTERY. THE BATTERY STARTED TO SMOKE MIDFLIGHT AND CAUSED A SMALL FIRE. AIRCREW PLACED THE BATTERY IN A THERMAL CONTAINMENT BAG AND PUT WATER IN THE BAG. AIRCRAFT DIVERTED AND PASSENGERS DEPLANED NORMALLY WHILE MAINTENANCE INSPECTED THE AIRCRAFT. LOCAL FD CONFISCATED THE MATERIAL. CARPET OF THE AIRCRAFT WAS BURNED. THE ONLY INJURY REPORTED WAS SHORTNESS OF BREATH OF A NEARBY PASSENGER. ITINERARY OF THE AIRCRAFT WAS FROM PHILADELPHIA TO PHOENIX. AIRCRAFT IS STILL IN VIRGINIA. THERE IS CURRENTLY NO PLAN FOR DELAYED PASSENGERS.

Report Description
SOLDIERS FROM A VESSEL IN THE 3RD PORT OPERATIONS FACILITY, FORT EUSTIS VA. HAD COMPLETED DISCHARGING BILGE WATER, AND WERE UNCOUPLING THE HOSE WHEN THEY ENCOUNTERED UNEXPECTED PRESSURE IN THE DISCHARGE LINE. THE PRESSURE CAUSED THE OPERATOR TO DISCHARGE APPROXIMATELY FIVE GALLONS OF BILGE WATER ONTO THE PIER, WITH APPROXIMATELY ONE GALLON ENTERING THE WATERS OF SKIFFES CREEK. IN ACCORDANCE WITH SOPS THE VESSEL HAD UTILIZED CONTAINMENT BOOM BEFORE OPERATIONS BEGAN. ALL CONTAMINATION WAS CONTAINED INSIDE THE BOOM, AND CREWS ARE CONDUCTING CLEAN UP OPERATIONS.

Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: CITY OF WESTLAND
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 42.316024, -83.405235 (Approximated from street_address)
Report Description
CALLER STATED THAT, AS A NORMAL PRACTICE, THE CITY OF WESTLAND PUMPS RAW SEWAGE INTO THE STREETS OF THE NEIGHBORING CITY OF INKSTER TO AVOID SEWER BACK UPS WITH IN THE CITY OF WESTLAND. CALLER STATED THAT THE CITY OF WESTLAND ALSO PUMPS THOUSANDS OF GALLONS OF RAW SEWAGE INTO THE STORM DRAINS USING MULTIPLE MOBILE HIGH CAPACITY 6" DIESEL PUMPS THROUGHOUT THE CITY. THE CITY ALSO DUMPS TRUCK LOADS OF RAW SEWAGE AT THE ADDRESS PROVIDED, WHERE IT IS ALLOWED TO FLOW INTO THE NEARBY WOODS WHICH ARE ADJACENT TO RESIDENTIAL HOMES. THE CITY HAS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEES TO REPAIR LEAD WATER SERVICE PIPES INSTEAD OF REPLACING THEM. THE CITY HAS FABRICATED REPORTS GIVEN TO THE DEQ CONCERNING LEAD LEVELS AND WATER QUALITY. CITY WITHHELD WATER QUALITY TEST RESULTS FROM CITIZENS. IMPROPER WATER QUALITY SAMPLING PROCESSES. THE INCIDENT DATE IS AN APPROXIMATE TIME THE LAST HEAVY RAIN FELL IN THE AREA, WHICH THESE OCCURRENCE ARE THE STANDARD PROCEDURES DURING TIMES OF HEAVY RAIN.
